summary_en: SR-fPAM uses dual-wavelength, label-free spatiotemporal tracking of individual red blood cells to reconstruct super-resolved three-dimensional microvascular architecture while measuring flow and oxygenation. The system uses a transparent micro-ring-resonator ultrasound detector and demonstrates functional imaging of oxygen-hemodynamic redistribution after single-vessel stroke in live mice.

summary_en: This Nature Protocols paper gives a customizable end-to-end fabrication and characterization workflow for optically transparent ultrasound transducers. By allowing light and ultrasound to share a coaxial path, the devices remove the alignment and aperture compromises of opaque commercial transducers and directly support compact photoacoustic-ultrasound and related multimodal systems.
